source_clauses.source_claim: Classify up to geometry isomorphism all firm, residually connected PSL(3,4)-flag-transitive RWPRI IP2 geometries; local2T is an output, not an assumed filter. Ranks2,3,4,5,>=6 give7,7,11,4,0.
Distinct parabolics, left cosets, incidence by nonempty intersection; flags/chambers, residues, firmness, kernels, faithful action, RWPRI/IP2/local2T, type-preserving Aut versus Cor.
qualifications: correlations preserve the partition into whole types; markers are separate

source_clauses.source_claim: A pregeometry is a residually connected geometry iff its displayed subgroup lattice is strongly Boolean.

source_clauses.source_claim: For an arbitrary chosen alpha(J) in each nonempty J, full geometry/flag transitivity iff intersection of Gj*Galpha equals (intersection Gj)*Galpha for all |J|>=3.

qualifications: displayed two cross-intersections alone do not imply the claimed unique opposite pole; all four cross-intersections are imposed in the certified recipe

retained_inputs.claim: The quoted strongly-Boolean connectivity criterion, with its source hypotheses; retained attribution. The present proof uses the separately acquired full panel-recognition theorem, not a weaker reading of this sentence.
The quoted anchored-coset Helly criterion; its actual general implementation and proof are acquired in the common theory and broad primitive preparation.
Classical PG(2,4) terminology and uniqueness of the plane are retained. Concrete hyperoval/Baer sets, orbits, butterfly completions and actions used here are separately certified.

The exact rank>=3 doubling antecedent with its I12 condition is retained, not strengthened to Pasini full intersection property or extended to rank2. Four finite doubles have actual maps; the rank2 case has a separate elementary proof.

Historical thesis reduction, earlier subgroup-geometry classification and Cayley/Magma calculations remain attributed history. The present completeness proof uses the acquired broad panel enumeration and does not claim to replay those older programs.
ATLAS naming convention retained; actual subgroup and Aut/Cor identifications are supplied by literal structure/action certificates, not by names or cardinality alone.

Earlier named constructions cited at individual diagrams, including Gewirtz and unital graph names, remain attributed antecedents. The fixed source supplies no fresh proof of those external identifications; this packet does not claim new acquisition of all primary articles.

Complete TomLib L3(4) subgroup roster and transported complete local maximal-subgroup data; exact GAP group/homomorphism/transporter algorithms and full automorphism computation; exact GRAPE/nauty colored-graph completeness are explicit computational/classification premises. Small controls and positive maps do not reprove those algorithms or tables.
